MOLECULAR PATHOLOGY REPORT
[redacted location] Cancer Center

PATIENT INFORMATION
Name: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Age/Sex: 70 year old Female
Ordering Physician: Dr. [redacted name]
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INFORMATION
Diagnosis: Metastatic non-small cell lung adenocarcinoma (NSCLC)
Specimen Type: Tissue biopsy
Tumor Content: 80%

TESTS PERFORMED
1. Interphase Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH)
   - ALK gene rearrangement analysis
   - ROS1 gene rearrangement analysis

2. Next-Generation Sequencing
   - GenomeTech Rapid-Seq EGFR Pathway Panel
   - Genes analyzed: EGFR, KRAS, NRAS, BRAF

FISH ANALYSIS RESULTS

METHODOLOGY
Interphase FISH analysis was performed on formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue sections using dual-color break-apart probes.

ALK (2p23) REARRANGEMENT ANALYSIS
Probe: Vysis ALK Break Apart FISH Probe Kit
Cells Analyzed: 50
Result: NEGATIVE for ALK rearrangement
Pattern: 2-6 fusion signals per cell
Interpretation: No evidence of ALK gene rearrangement

ROS1 (6q22) REARRANGEMENT ANALYSIS  
Probe: Vysis ROS1 Break Apart FISH Probe Kit
Cells Analyzed: 50
Result: NEGATIVE for ROS1 rearrangement
Pattern: 2-6 fusion signals per cell
Interpretation: No evidence of ROS1 gene rearrangement

MOLECULAR SEQUENCING RESULTS

METHODOLOGY
Next-generation sequencing was performed using the GenomeTech Rapid-Seq EGFR Pathway Panel. DNA was extracted from FFPE tissue and libraries were prepared using hybrid capture technology. Sequencing was performed with minimum coverage of 500x. Variant calling was performed using dual bioinformatics algorithms with a limit of detection of 5% variant allele frequency.

SEQUENCING RESULTS

EGFR (NM_005228.5)
Variant Detected: c.2335_2336delinsTT, p.(Gly779Phe)
Location: Exon 20
Variant Allele Frequency: 59%
Coverage at Position: 1,245x
Classification: Variant of Uncertain Significance

KRAS (NM_033360.4)
Result: No pathogenic variants detected
Coverage: Mean 892x, Minimum 650x
Regions Analyzed: Codons 12, 13, 59, 61, 117, 146

NRAS (NM_002524.5)
Result: No pathogenic variants detected  
Coverage: Mean 756x, Minimum 512x
Regions Analyzed: Codons 12, 13, 59, 61, 117, 146

BRAF (NM_004333.6)
Result: No pathogenic variants detected
Coverage: Mean 823x, Minimum 589x
Regions Analyzed: Codons 469, 594, 596, 597, 600, 601

INTERPRETATION

The EGFR p.Gly779Phe (c.2335_2336delinsTT) variant detected in exon 20 is a rare alteration in NSCLC. This variant results in substitution of glycine with phenylalanine at codon 779. Limited clinical data are available regarding the response of this specific variant to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). Some exon 20 alterations have been associated with resistance to first and second-generation EGFR TKIs.

FISH analysis showed no evidence of ALK or ROS1 gene rearrangements. The presence of 2-6 gene copies is within the normal range and does not indicate gene amplification. No actionable therapeutic variants were identified in KRAS, NRAS, or BRAF genes.

RECOMMENDATIONS

1. The patient is unlikely to benefit from ALK or ROS1 targeted inhibitors based on negative FISH results.

2. The clinical significance of the EGFR p.Gly779Phe variant for TKI response remains uncertain due to limited data.

3. Clinical correlation and multidisciplinary team discussion recommended for treatment planning.

Electronically signed by:
[redacted name], MD, PhD
Board Certified in Molecular Genetic Pathology
